values.description: Read the public key and its version from transit/keys/<key> at startup, inside context refresh — the default when the property is unset. A Vault that cannot serve the read fails the boot.

Read the same atomic pair at the signer's first use instead, so the application starts while Vault is still sealing, unsealing or mounting; a Vault that is not ready fails the first send or health probe rather than the boot. Only valid without public-key — the supplied mode performs no metadata read.
